rows.note: The verification document records visual-capable clauses as verified and gives an automatic node-test run, but it records no separate visual inspection or source-bound desktop/tablet observations.

findings.message: The artifact marks D-STORY:AC-002 verified and cites a node test run, but the pinned plan requires Playwright for circle geometry and the implementation summary says no governed test execution is retained. This evidence does not establish that the Playwright circle geometry test ran.
findings.quote: No governed test execution is retained yet; fresh publication checks may establish them.

findings.message: D-STORY:AC-004 is marked verified with no tagged test, and the artifact provides no desktop/tablet visual inspection. The plan explicitly separates visual acceptance from automated success, so the verification claim is unsupported.
findings.quote: Visual acceptance remains a separate inspection against the pinned screenshot and at representative desktop/tablet sizes; automated success does not establish visual acceptance.

findings.message: The artifact recommends release with 9 of 10 requirements verified, but AC-002 lacks a demonstrated Playwright run and AC-004 lacks visual or tagged-test evidence. The overall release claim is not supported by the recorded evidence.
findings.quote: The graph area remains visible and usable at representative desktop and common tablet widths.
